name: walk_look_up
text: Walking forward while looking high up at the sky, chin lifted noticeably, face angled upward toward a tall tower. Keep the head tipped back and the gaze up while walking slowly, with loose swinging arms.

trim.reason: Select the reviewed complete middle cycle, avoiding start/end settling.

review.notes_zh: 持续抬头看高处建筑并交替迈步；自由生成抬头不足，采用已验收look_up第60帧的头部朝向作全身关键帧参考重新生成，再提取完整步态循环。参考姿势不是直接拼进成品。
